compatibility.mapping: Separately versioned application/evidence envelopes map exact source schemas; unknown required fields refuse; adapter loss map required.
compatibility.canonical_owner: existing authenticated fenced kernel writer; receipt journal retains its own canonical provenance and cut; no diagnostic writer

fields.source_ref: authorized immutable evidence reference or null

rules: Only known permits numeric zero.
Invalid raw meter values may remain in raw evidence; validated quantity is null.
A redacted existence/count may itself be withheld.
A sequence is not a clock, cursor, lease or authority grant.
Independent domains have explicit cut vectors and causal joins, not invented global total order.
Missing epoch is typed unknown/not_applicable, never silently zero.
Do not collapse namespaces.
No hidden inference or ambient clock/network reads.
Historical values only; counterfactuals separately labeled.

fields.outstanding_reserved_upper_bound: admitted reservations including admitted recovery work and uncertain liabilities
fields.control_reserve: still-unallocated withheld headroom, disjoint from outstanding

rules: For disjoint representation: settled + outstanding + control_reserve + proposed <= limit.
Uncertain liabilities and admitted recovery already belong to outstanding; do not add them again.
Admission atomically transfers relevant allowed unallocated headroom into outstanding; ordinary work cannot consume withheld control headroom.
Alternative tagged representation: settled + total_outstanding_including_tagged_control + proposed <= limit, with no extra control term.
Never mix representations or mint headroom by transferring a reservation.

fields.current_read_scope: currently authorized domain/audience/purpose before lookup and disclosure
fields.immutable_command_identity: content_digest is immutable equality/conflict predicate under the canonical key; actor_id/auth_ref stay inside command bytes
fields.historical_receipt: original disposition/cut, separate from current effect authorization
fields.canonical_operation_key: (admitted_authority_domain, command_id); canonical ID already incorporates any explicit client namespace mapping

rules: Authenticate and authorize current reader/domain before lookup or disclosure, including existence metadata.
Same-domain/same-ID/different-digest is conflict, not exact duplicate; actor/auth_ref changes alter immutable command identity.
Different domain never finds a receipt by ID alone; changed caller needs its own current read authorization.
Revoked read scope refuses; permitted historical receipt after effect revocation never redispatches or restores a grant.
Production qualification obligation only: frozen M1A is pure sanitized in-memory synthetic-authority scope, not a claimed cross-user defect or amendment.
Principal-local client IDs require an explicit injective durable mapping into canonical IDs before lookup; transport request IDs are audit metadata, not a new canonical operation namespace.

contracts.name: EventEvidenceEnvelope
contracts.owner: canonical writer admits evidence; upstream producer claims remain observations

fields.schema_profile: exact source schema plus envelope version
fields.producer: authenticated component identity or explicit unverified claimed origin
fields.causal_edges: typed ordered edge records with origin receipt
fields.payload: closed typed decision/observation reference, never arbitrary raw body

invariants: Required events are retained before disposable presentation.
No raw credentials/hidden reasoning.
A source report is not an externally verified fact.
Trace IDs and signatures confer no task grant.

contracts.name: DecisionRecord
contracts.owner: existing decision/admission authority; proposed annotations non-authoritative

fields.candidate_universe: sorted finite descriptor refs + discovery completeness
fields.receipt_ref: accepted/refused command receipt; refusal need not be canonical state event
fields.optional_explanation_ref: non-authoritative annotation; never needed for core replay
fields.resource_accounting: ResourceReservationAccounting when the decision concerns admission/resources

invariants: Every required operand retained or re-derivation unknown.
Old accepted duplicate receipt is not fresh admission.
No current grant restored by historical replay.

Current reader/domain authorization precedes lookup/disclosure. The canonical key is (admitted_authority_domain, canonical_command_id). Under that key, immutable content_digest including actor/auth_ref is an equality/conflict check, not a namespace component; changed bytes conflict without redispatch.
Returning an allowed historical receipt preserves history and never redispatches after effect revocation.

fields.source_cut: SourceCut or explicit multi-domain cut vector

invariants: No advertised snapshot without verified bytes.
Content and installed cursor commit atomically.
Viewer cache cannot alter reservations or grants.
Wrong scope/generation/digest refuses.

invariants: Same complete identity gives same canonical answer.
Optional annotation cannot change authority or required data.
Any execution/model attempt rejects model-free path.

fields.interval: allowed sequence/range or opaque unavailable marker

contracts.name: ReplayDiagnostic
contracts.owner: isolated read-only replay worker; no actuator capabilities

fields.checkpoint_binding: actual state bytes + manifest + trusted source cut + source convention
fields.bounded_diff: field path/reason + permitted reference, no raw payload leakage

invariants: No model/tool/effect re-execution.
Missing expected digest is unverified.
Group-only evidence gives group-local failure, not invented event localization.
Replay output cannot write live state.

contracts.name: MeterObservation
contracts.owner: read-only evidence collector; canonical ledger applies validated reconciliation

fields.reconciliation: dedup keys, inclusive/exclusive grouping, reset evidence, source report refs
fields.ledger_effect: consumed increment or held liability; distinct reservation identity
fields.classes: tokens/cache classes/subscription debit/money/host/human time remain separate
fields.reservation_accounting: ResourceReservationAccounting; quantity observation never reallocates withheld headroom

invariants: Crash reported zero can be invalid actual usage.
Parent-inclusive plus child cannot double count.
Reset and fork do not renew task budget.
Uncertain liability remains subset of held reservation.
Still-unallocated control headroom is disjoint from outstanding; admitted recovery and uncertain liabilities already count within outstanding; tagged-control alternative adds no second reserve term.

contracts.name: DiagnosticRecord

fields.facts: predicate operands and retained observation refs

invariants: No autonomous executive, self-activation or remediation.
Unknown coverage cannot mean healthy.
Diagnostic text grants no permission.

contracts.name: ExportManifest
invariants: Off by default; no endpoint contacted during fixtures.
No raw prompts/source/tool outputs/paths/credentials/global IDs/private digests.
Errors and filenames follow same policy.
Hash equality is not privacy assurance.
